title: Compute sigurnost i GenAI guardrails
summary: Hardened AMI i container image, uloge za EC2/Lambda/ECS/EKS, Inspector i GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring, Patch Manager, Session Manager i IMDSv2, skeniranje u pipeline-u i zaštita GenAI aplikacija (OWASP Top 10 for LLM, Bedrock Guardrails).
summary_en: Hardened AMIs and container images, roles for EC2/Lambda/ECS/EKS, Inspector and GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring, Patch Manager, Session Manager and IMDSv2, scanning in the pipeline, and protecting GenAI applications (OWASP Top 10 for LLM, Bedrock Guardrails).
